title: Garden Food Groove
hook: Name the produce A to Z!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D garden-food storybook, raised beds and produce, leafy greens with bright vegetables, clean subjects

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 uses shape, skin, leaf, root, color or market/garden clues without diet lectures or repetitive 'healthy food' claims.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses color/shape recall and a point, trace, round, long, leafy or basket gesture after the word.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: bright marimba/ukulele pluck that changes contour every few letters.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: bright marimba/ukulele pluck that changes contour every few letters
